product_one_liner.value: interface.ai provides agentic AI assistants that automate customer service and transactions across voice, chat, and employee-assisted channels for credit unions and community banks.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing link or plans page was found in site navigation; the /pricing address yielded no readable page.

founded_year.notes: The company timeline identifies 2019 as the birth of interface.ai; predecessor Payjo operated during 2015–2018.

eng_blog.notes: The blog is aimed at financial-institution leaders and contains product, industry, and marketing articles; no qualifying engineering-authored series about building the product was found.

public_docs.notes: No public product-documentation or help-center link was found; docs.interface.ai and help.interface.ai yielded no readable documentation. Security reports and marketing resources are not product documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Live posting: Applied AI Engineer, Business Automation; responsibilities include applied AI/LLM engineering and agentic workflows.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed platform descriptions, security/compliance material, privacy policy, blog results, and the trust center’s subprocessor section. Public material describes multiple LLMs but does not establish a named production model provider; subprocessor details were not publicly readable.

compliance_certs.notes: Trust center lists SOC 2 Type 2, ISO/IEC 27001:2022, and GDPR. GDPR is a compliance claim, not a certification in the same sense as ISO 27001.

last_funding.notes: Company reports $30M Series A financing; funding records distinguish $20M equity and $10M debt in the same October 2024 financing. No newer corroborated announcement was found.

raised_18mo.notes: Latest corroborated financing announcement is October 2024, before the 2025-05-09 cutoff. One database lists later uncorroborated entries, which could not be verified in company announcements.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live careers board lists an Account Executive opening in San Francisco.

launched_6mo.notes: The dated September 17 / October 1, 2026 customer announcement introduces the new Assemble console and V6 sandbox, enabling self-service configuration, governance, testing, and analytics; this is a major capability introduction within the six-month window, not a bug fix.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The June 18, 2026 company announcement introduces new executive hires Michael Azevedo (VP, Sales) and Bryan Dooley (SVP, Customer Experience).

crm_stack_signal.notes: Technical Support Engineer posting requires resolving escalated tickets and maintaining audit-ready case documentation in Salesforce Service Cloud.
